name: Phaseclaw Causeway
introDiscord:
A stone causeway flickers between solid and transparent.

Phaseclaw Lobsters occasionally flicker with it.
introTwitch:
A stone causeway flickers between solid and transparent.

Phaseclaw Lobsters occasionally flicker with it.

phaseclaw-causeway-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Phaseclaw Causeway.

left.message:
A Lobster phases through the bridge, pops back in, and pinches you.

Unfair technology.

right.message:
A coffer exists at roughly 60% opacity.

Treasure remains 100% usable.

forward.message: A section of bridge remembers being a restorative shrine.
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

phaseclaw-causeway-depths.prompt: Deeper within Phaseclaw Causeway, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message:
Star Candies phase in and out of your hands.

Eventually you win.

right.message: A Phaseclaw Lobster attacks while partially nonexistent.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's note:

'Tried walking through wall.

Wall chose to become real halfway.

Ow.'

phaseclaw-causeway-threshold.prompt: Near Half-Real Arena, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A fully-real patch of restorative water stabilizes you.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A cache becomes solid exactly long enough to loot.

forward.message: A Lobster emerges halfway through the floor.

bossPromptDiscord:
Half-Real Arena flickers.

The guardian inside alternates between present, absent, and deeply
inconvenient.

Use /yes to enter or /no to wait until reality finishes
loading.
bossPromptTwitch:
Half-Real Arena flickers.

The guardian inside alternates between present, absent, and deeply
inconvenient.

Use !yes to enter or !no to wait until reality finishes
loading.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Half-Real Arena. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The creature stabilizes just enough to attack.

Between-State Clawlord reveals itself!

completionText:
The Causeway becomes solid.

Shizuki wrote:

'FINALLY.'

Then the word phases out.
